EMINENT is an Erasmus Mundus master dedicated to embedded and cyber-physical systems, delivered by a European consortium of technical universities. The programme page carries the live application dates, scholarship information and mobility structure for the next cohort.

Programme Highlights

  • Embedded-systems specialisation with real-time and hardware-software co-design
  • Industry-linked projects across the consortium's technology partners
  • Application dates announced per cohort on the official site
  • Graduates enter automotive, aerospace, telecom and semiconductor R&D

Who Should Apply

Electrical, computer and software engineering graduates with strong C/RTOS and systems fundamentals fit the curriculum.

Funding and Costs

Erasmus Mundus scholarships for selected students per the live call.

Deadline and How to Apply

Follow the EMINENT website for the live call and submit through the consortium's admission form. Key deadline information: Current application dates published on the official programme page.

Official Link

  • Official application page (verified link)

About EMINENT Consortium

The EMINENT consortium delivers the Erasmus Mundus Joint Master in Embedded Systems with European technical universities and embedded-industry partners.

Official website: https://eminent-master.eu

Contact

Questions about this position, eligibility or the application process should be raised through the contact channel given on the official announcement page (see the Official Link section above). Always quote the position reference in your message so the admissions or HR team can route your enquiry quickly.

Important Notes

  • Application deadline: See official page for dates - late or incomplete applications are normally not considered.
  • Listing details were recorded from the official source at the time of publication; always confirm the latest requirements on the official page before applying.
  • Prepare the documents listed in the eligibility and application sections before starting the online form - transcripts, CV and references take the longest to collect.
